title: Attention Spotlight Simulator
description: Learners steer an attention spotlight to keep a boring target task lit while pulsing distractors capture the beam, experiencing selecting, sustaining, resisting capture, and shifting as separate skills with visible costs.
creator: Arun Batchu
subject: ADHD
Attention
Attention Regulation
Psychology
audience: People with ADHD, Family members, Students, Educators
